BEN.note: The committee is to anticipate AI developments and alert authorities; no rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
No government use of an AI system is stated.
No AI tool in a sector's public system is stated.
No locally built AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
The article concerns state data security, not a data protection law.

facts.fact: Decree 2026-579 of 2 September 2026 created a National Digital Committee under the President, with protection of strategic data among its priorities and a mandate to give a prior opinion on technology partnerships that could engage national digital sovereignty.
